test_title: PYST 1: SSC CGL 2025 Tier-I Similar Paper - English (Held On: 12th Sep 2025 Shift 1)
subject: english
question:
Convert to active voice:

It was being suggested by several sources that the operation had been compromised from within.

options.text: Several sources were suggesting that the operation had been compromised from within.
Several sources have suggested that the operation was compromised from within.
Several sources suggest that the operation is compromised from within.
Several sources are suggesting that the operation would be compromised from within.

solution:
The correct answer is **Option 1**.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** 

__
 
• The given sentence is in the passive voice: "It was being suggested by several sources..."
 
• To convert it to active voice, the doer of the action ("several sources") must become the subject.
 
• The passive verb form "was being suggested" changes to the active progressive form "were suggesting."
 
• The remaining part of the sentence ("that the operation had been compromised from within") stays unchanged.
 
• Thus, the active voice sentence becomes: "Several sources were suggesting that the operation had been compromised from within."

Therefore, the correct answer is **Option 1**.

 

**Correct Sentence:** *"Several sources were suggesting that the operation had been compromised from within."* 

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__** 

 
• **Option 2:** Changes the tense to "have suggested," which does not match the original continuous passive meaning.
 
• **Option 3:** Uses simple present "suggest," incorrect because the original sentence indicates an ongoing past action.
 
• **Option 4:** Uses "would be compromised," which alters the meaning completely and is grammatically incorrect in context.
